notes.title: Speedrunning tournament ongoing until 25/08
notes.content:
We are placing the following speedrun bounties for version 1.4:

any% (reach the exit)

     1st place: 50 USD
     2nd place: 30 USD
     3rd place: 20 USD
     4th place: 10 USD

100% (reach the exit with all collectibles)

     1st place: 50 USD
     2nd place: 30 USD
     3rd place: 20 USD
     4th place: 10 USD

How to participate: send unedited video of your run at https://www.speedrun.com/Necrosphere64 (run time is shown in end of credits)

Deadline and bounty payout: 25/08 at 23h59 UTC 🗓️ 

NOTE: this is the deadline to have your video uploaded, it's ok if verification happens after the deadline

Join our discord to chat with devs and other runners! https://discord.com/invite/2Er6xTzCkH


Developer Notes on Steam Release (1.4)

I'm super happy that we finally released on Steam, plus the soundtrack is awesome (thanks a lot Patricia!), we have some small updates to do in the game from release feedback but not before throwing in a small competition for the current version of the game to make sure we stress this version well and the future 1.5 release contains all needed patches for a longer time without updates!

I'll be around collecting feedback to see what could be added in for version 1.5, feel free to chat with us!

If you bought the game in Steam, please leave your review to us: every single review helps us in reaching more players! Thanks a lot for being here with us!
